tests.cmd: cd desktop && cargo test -p meshd control::
tests.covers: heartbeats under telemetry load (≥3 in 25 s), secret reconnect supersedes and closes the old socket, wrong secret → Bye, plan re-sent on reconnect + has_plan, failure report honoured only for the current plan id, idle vs member disconnect, forget → Bye + close, silent link dropped, pre-auth 4 KiB frame cap, 5 s Hello deadline

tests.name: Android JVM unit tests
tests.covers: HostArgsTest: phone host split rule == derive_args (ngl+1, head pinned, 0.440000,0.560000), single worker no split, no workers ngl 0, Locale-independent decimals
tests.evidence: tests=15 failures=0 (HostArgsTest 4, ProcessGateTest 8, StopReportTest 3), gradle-r9.log 04:29 IST

tests.name: run/forget guards on a live run
tests.covers: 416 carries Content-Range */len; POST /api/run with a phone host and no --lan → 422 and the current run stays ready; DELETE /api/devices/{id} on a run member → run error 'was forgotten', device removed
tests.evidence: PASS 04:31 IST (round-9 build, run-guards.sh ALL OK, 27 checks): refusals (--lan, n_ctx, unknown model, 8B shortfall) 422 with the run still ready; replacement path with the laptop MEASURED: an immediate re-run during loading is accepted with credited=[] (proves 'not ready earns no credit'); after ready the ctx-4096 re-run is accepted and the credit for local was 0 B ≤ the 868 MB placement (a 0.6 GB mmap'd model shows no MemAvailable drop 3 s after ready — the rule credits only the observed drop, so nothing was over-credited); forget member → error, device removed. What this does NOT show: a case where the credit changes the planner's answer on real hardware (only the unit test does)
